Hi Sofie / team —

Great to meet earlier — really appreciated the walkthrough of your cataloging workload and the latency targets for the search UI. Per our call, I’m attaching the pricing deck and a capacity-backed estimate for the 3-month pilot we discussed (conservative burst and steady-state rows included). Key points: 

- Pilot sizing: 2 x A100-equivalent instances (dedicated) with autoscale policy for peak indexing windows
- Estimated 90th p99 latency: ~120ms on the configured profile
- Cost: line-item monthly estimate included in the attached spreadsheet (sheet: ‘Pilot_estimate_v2’)

Attachments: ClearHarbor_Redwood_Pricing_Deck_v2.pdf, ClearHarbor_capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) Confirm receipt of the deck/estimate
2) Quick walkthrough (15–30m) with your engineering + procurement to walk assumptions and slack in the estimate
3) If happy, we can put a mutual action plan together for an isolated pilot (legal + infra checklist)

I’ve included Marcus (solutions engineering) on the thread — he can join any walkthrough. Are you available for a quick call next week (Nov 24–25) or early Dec? If those don’t work, send a couple times and we’ll adapt.

Thanks —

Wanted to surface a one-paragraph summary to make review faster in case the deck is long for others on your side. Inline here are the headline numbers from the deck/estimate: 

- Pilot term: 3 months; expected tokens: indexing-heavy first 2 weeks, then steady generation workload for search rerank
- Provisioning: 2 dedicated GPU nodes (baseline), capacity headroom with burst policy; expected monthly cost (hosted + infra) ~$12,400–$14,200 (range depends on burst minutes)
- Optional: smaller dev cluster for canary + QA (~$2,100/mo)

Attachments referenced again: ClearHarbor_Redwood_Pricing_Deck_v2.pdf (slides) and ClearHarbor_capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx (line-items).
